summary: VASP jobs 9738672-9738677 are DONE and all six exact-structure force labels passed scheduler, normal-completion, electronic, force, magnetic, structure, remote-hash, and SIGMA=0.20 compatibility gates. MatRIS passed every force ceiling but failed the relative-energy RMSE ceiling at 0.144987 eV; AQCat25 passed all screening ceilings. The policy therefore triggers an energy-force-aware MatRIS fine-tuning candidate, but no fine-tuning or path rerun was submitted.

payload.objective: Prepare a held-out-exclusion-bound energy-force-aware MatRIS replay fine-tuning request for review; obtain separate user authorization before any MZ73 fine-tuning execution or new-checkpoint complete-path rerun.
current_evidence: All six labels pass normal VASP completion, electronic convergence, exact 50-atom structure/order, complete all-atom forces, total and atom-resolved magnetic evidence, remote/local output hashes, and the active SIGMA=0.20 fingerprint.
MatRIS movable-atom metrics are component MAE 0.042561 eV/A, vector RMSE 0.107984 eV/A, vector max 0.333501 eV/A, and relative-energy RMSE 0.144987 eV.
MatRIS passes the three force ceilings but fails only the 0.10 eV relative-energy RMSE ceiling; its lowest-energy structure matches VASP.

AQCat25 movable-atom metrics are component MAE 0.042642 eV/A, vector RMSE 0.120423 eV/A, vector max 0.460680 eV/A, and relative-energy RMSE 0.060631 eV; all screening ceilings pass and its lowest-energy structure matches VASP.
The six VASP energies remain force-label-only and are not reportable final barrier energies.
No real three-member MatRIS committee exists, so no quantitative uncertainty or uncertainty-error quadrant claim is made.
The active-learning acceleration remains uncalibrated until a new checkpoint, complete-path rerun, and disjoint held-out TS validation pass.
payload.one_executable_step: Prepare the hash-bound MatRIS energy-force-aware replay fine-tuning request with frozen held-out exclusions; do not submit it without separate user authorization.
payload.submission_boundary: Fine-tuning, checkpoint promotion, complete ML-path rerun, VASP micro-NEB, Dimer, and final barrier actions remain unauthorized. The completed static labels cannot enter the final-energy chain.
done_when: A fine-tuning request verifies the MatRIS trigger assessment, all six quality-passed labels, the frozen held-out exclusions, adsorption replay, active policy, and base checkpoint.
The user separately authorizes or declines the reviewed MZ73 fine-tuning execution.
